hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import sys, json, os
try:
    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
    fp = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')
    ext = os.path.splitext(fp)[1]
    if ext in ('.py', '.html', '.js', '.css', '.md'):
        name = os.path.basename(fp)
        print(f'[SYNC CHECK] {name} modified. Per CLAUDE.md rules:')
        print('  README.md <-> README_EN.md  (if docs/features changed)')
        print('  web/static/{index.html,app.js} + web/runner.py  (if features changed)')
        print('  src/survey_agent/state.py + .env.example  (if new config/state added)')
except Exception:
    pass
"
